4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.

8:

10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-style Backrooms horror game for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Deliver the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support mobile touch controls and phone/tablet layouts.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game using Canvas raycasting rather than external 3D dependencies.
- Game objective: recover three recordings and reach the service exit while avoiding a pursuing entity.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface, responsive styling, maze gameplay, flashlight/battery, recordings, enemy pursuit, exit condition, audio cues, keyboard and touch controls.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started a local server at `http://localhost:3002`; browser opened the game and screenshots were captured.

### Active
- Validate the in-game view and gameplay behavior; the latest screenshot was captured and read, but its appearance was not described in the conversation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and fix any visual or gameplay issues found in the latest screenshot/browser checks.
2. Verify mobile layout and touch controls, and check browser console for runtime errors.
3. Summarize the finished work and note reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and overlays.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and mobile touch control styling.
- `game.js`: Canvas renderer, maze generation, game state, audio, input, and gameplay loop.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent in-game screenshot.

## Important Context
- Playwright initially reported a missing Chromium install; Chromium was installed and the browser opened successfully.
- The only console error reported was a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), not a game runtime error.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-style Backrooms horror game for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Deliver the playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support mobile touch controls and phone/tablet layouts.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained Canvas raycasting game without external 3D dependencies.
- Objective: recover three recordings and reach the service exit while avoiding a pursuing entity.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created responsive game UI, maze renderer, flashlight and battery, recordings, enemy pursuit, exit condition, audio cues, and keyboard/touch controls.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser opened at `http://localhost:3002`; latest gameplay screenshot was captured and read.

### Active
- Validate the current gameplay view and fix any visual or gameplay issues.
- Verify mobile layout/touch behavior and check browser console for runtime errors.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the latest screenshot and investigate any issues; the screenshot was read but its appearance was not described.
2. Run gameplay and mobile checks; distinguish any actual runtime errors from the known favicon 404.
3. Summarize the finished work and note reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and overlays.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual styling and mobile touch controls.
- `game.js`: Canvas renderer, maze, game state, audio, input, and gameplay loop.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent in-game screenshot (ignored by Git).

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The only console error previously reported was `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found) @ http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico:0`.
- Latest browser snapshot showed the game remained on the title overlay, while HUD battery and timer updated behind it; investigate whether simulation/HUD advancing before game start is intended.
- Files currently show as untracked in `git status`; `node --check game.js` succeeded.
